description: The Apple Ads ad accounts these credentials can act as, with the roles held on each, plus the organization’s currency, time zone and payment model. NAMING: Apple’s older API called these “organizations” (campaign groups) and its Platform API calls them AD ACCOUNTS — the id is the same number, and `orgId` and `adAccountId` on each row are equal. One login can cover several: an agency managing multiple clients has one per client. Reading this does NOT switch account: Apple Ads is pinned to the ONE chosen when the connection was made, so an agent can never act as another client’s. To use a different one, pick it in Connectors > Apple Ads > Manage accounts, with set_connector_accounts, or by reconnecting. A payment model of null is worth reporting: Apple states that without one, campaigns cannot run. Read-only, free.
name: list_apple_ads_orgs
title: List Apple Ads organizations
